posts.name: Jason Chollar
posts.blurb: What worked more smoothly for me: set up a free account at https://my.plaid.com/ first and link all your banks there. Then, when you connect the Finance plugin, sign in with that same Plaid account so your institutions are ready to share. It saves reopening Plaid for each bank one at a time.
